title: Settings
openSourceA11y: Open the Selftend source code on GitHub

profile.permissionNeeded: Photo library access is needed to choose a profile picture.
profile.tooLarge: Choose an image smaller than 5 MB.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Reminders stay explicit and off by default. You choose which ones to turn on.

onboarding.replaySaved: The app introduction will be shown again. Your Home widgets stay unchanged.
onboarding.tipsSaved: Optional button tips can appear again.
onboarding.appBody1: Work through something, or just do one small thing today. Modules - CBT or ACT - take you step by step; eight everyday tools take a few minutes and ask nothing of you. You'll choose in a moment, and you can change it later.
onboarding.appBody2: Selftend is not a diagnosis tool, therapy replacement, or emergency support. Use local emergency or crisis resources if you need urgent help.
onboarding.wizConcernsBody: Pick anything that fits - it shapes your dashboard and the starter routine offered next. You can change it later, and nothing here is a diagnosis.
onboarding.modulesQuestion: Would a self-help module be useful?
onboarding.modulesHint: Choose CBT, ACT, both, or neither. This is a preference, not an assessment.
onboarding.modulesOptional: Leave both unselected if you only want the everyday tools.
onboarding.cbtChoice: CBT - work with thoughts and behaviour
onboarding.actChoice: ACT - make room for feelings and act on values
onboarding.guidanceQuestion: How much structure would you like?
onboarding.guidanceHint: This choice applies to any modules you selected.
onboarding.guestInviteLine: You're using Selftend as a guest - you can create an account any time from Settings to protect your data.

guestInvite.title: Create an account to protect your data
guestInvite.body: You're using Selftend as a guest. An account keeps your data if this device is lost or replaced, and lets you sign in anywhere.
guestInvite.bodyWeb: You're using Selftend as a guest. Your data stays in this browser until you create an account - browsers can clear it.

security.appLockDescription: Require your fingerprint, face, or device passcode to open the app.
security.appLockUnavailable: Set up device biometrics or a passcode to enable the app lock.
security.appLockConfirm: Confirm to turn on the app lock

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: What we store, and how it is handled.

account.intro: Quiet defaults, and control over your account and data.
account.deleteDescription: This will permanently delete your account and all data including thought records, preferences, and profile. This cannot be undone.
account.deleteFailed: Deletion failed. Please try again or contact support.
account.signOutHint: You'll stay signed in on other devices.
account.deleteWarning: This action is permanent. Your account, profile, preferences, and app data will be deleted unless we are required to keep limited data for legal, security, or abuse-prevention reasons.

home.title: A calm starting point
home.description: The app starts with a single complete CBT section. Other modules stay out of the way until they are justified.

cookieConsent.banner: We use essential browser storage (localStorage) to keep you signed in. No tracking cookies are used. You can manage optional preferences below.
cookieConsent.preferencesDescription: Manage how the app uses browser storage on your device.
cookieConsent.essentialDescription: Required for authentication. Cannot be disabled.
cookieConsent.analyticsDescription: Not currently used. This preference will apply if analytics are added in the future.

consent.title: Quick policy check
consent.description: We keep this brief: please review and accept the latest Privacy Policy and Terms to continue.
consent.checkbox: I agree to the current Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
consent.healthDataCheckbox: I consent to Selftend processing the self-help entries I choose to save, including any wellness or mental-health reflection they contain, only to provide the app features I use.
consent.healthDataWithdrawal: This is a separate consent. You can withdraw it at any time by deleting your account or contacting privacy@selftend.org.
consent.error: Unable to save consent. Please try again.

supportPage.title: Support
supportPage.description: Reach a person, read the policies, or open the project.
supportPage.emailNotConfigured: Set EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_EMAIL before public launch. Until then, use GitHub issues for project feedback that does not include private health details.
supportPage.handles: What support can and can't do
canDo: Account deletion when the in-app flow fails

legal.title: Legal and boundaries
legal.description: Product boundaries, public policy pages, and launch-review reminders.
legal.launchReviewDescription: Policy text is in place for implementation review, but final organisation details, contact details, and legal approval are still required before public launch.
legal.productBoundaryDescription: This app is a CBT programme for your own use. It does not diagnose, prescribe, replace therapy, or act as emergency support.
legal.licenseDescription: The repository is planned under AGPL-3.0-only. Reference repos and curated resource lists may inform design decisions, but their code, text, and assets are not copied casually into this project.

feedback.title: Send a message
feedback.description: A bug, an idea, a question, or what's working. Leave out private entries and crisis details.

placeholder.bug: What happened, and what you expected instead.
placeholder.idea: What would you change, add, or remove?
placeholder.question: Ask anything about how the app or a tool works.
placeholder.helped: What worked, and how? It shapes what gets built next.

feedback.replyToHint: Used only to reply to this message. Leave empty to send anonymously.
feedback.replyToInvalid: Enter a valid email address, or leave the field empty.
feedback.attachNothing: Nothing from your journal, records, or check-ins is attached.
feedback.submitSuccess: Your feedback was sent. Thank you!
feedback.submitError: Failed to send feedback. Please try again.
feedback.rateLimited: You've sent a few messages recently. Please try again in an hour.
feedback.reportOnGitHubDescription: Public issue tracker for bugs and feature requests.
feedback.joinDiscordDescription: Other people using the app, plus the maintainers.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose a palette. This device only.
